sentences.text: Shri Sunil Gupta, learned Senior Counsel with Shri Sh  Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Rahul Solanki - Govt. Advocate for the responden Heard on the question of admission.

Also heard on I.A. No.15659/2025 , which is an application under Section 430 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of the appellant -Gaurav Patidar.

Vide judgment dated 8.11.2025 passed by the 4th Addl. Sessions Judge, Dhar in S.T. No.139/2021,
appellant has been convicted for the offence under Sections 376(1), 376(2)(n), 342 & 506(2) of IPC and sentenced to undergo 10 years RI with fine of Rs.2000/-, 10 years RI with fine of Rs.2000/-, 1 year RI with fine of Rs.1000/- and 2 years RI with fine of Rs.500/-, respectively, with usual default stipulation.
Counsel for the appellant submits that appellant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
The appeal is of the year 2025 and is not likely to be heard finally in near future.

Hence,
under such circumstances, prayer is made for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail.
2 CRA-11005-2025 Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer of the appellant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as Para-14 of the statement of victim (PW-1) coupled with the fact that final hearing of this appeal will take long time for its disposal, the application is allowed and it is directed that the execution of remaining jail sentence passed against the appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 23.01.2026 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry during the pendency of this appeal.
It is directed that the appellant shall not contact the victim (PW-1) either in person or through any social media platform.
If any violation of the condition is found, then this order shall be recalled.
